newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Overseas General sees block trade.
newsitem.headline: Overseas General sees block trade.

text.p: Gold exploration and mining company Overseas General saw a block of three million shares crossed at Australia $0.27, dealers said.
At 0731 GMT, Overseas rose A$0.03 to A$0.26 on 3.11 million shares including the block deal.
Dealers said they were not aware of any corporate development. The company could not be immediately reached for comments.

"There were some earlier reports that the company might pull out of its Australian and Singapore listing to list in Malaysia and that they could concentrate more on timber business," said a market source.
Malaysian-listed Land and General Bhd is a major shareholder of Overseas General.
